websiteEvidence.evidence: Reachable official KnightSwap GitBook contract documentation identifies the BSC factory and direct router separately. Directory uses attributable documentation, not a claim of current operating frontend, yield or incentives.

deploymentEvidence.evidence: Official KNIGHT Contracts page explicitly attributes ROUTER 0x05E61E0cDcD2170a76F9568a110CEe3AFdD6c46f to KnightSwap and describes its BSC factory. Independent exact-chain/address Sourcify record binds KnightRouter ABI/source and reports non-proxy deployment. Constructor arguments and immutable transformation values bind documented factory and canonical WBNB. No live RPC or runtime check performed.

abiEvidence.evidence: Full exact-deployment ABI retained unchanged. Reviewed all 792 lines of address-bound flattened source, including TransferHelper, SafeMath, PancakeLibrary and external pair/factory/wrapped-native interfaces. Its Pancake-named interfaces/revert strings do not substitute a generic Pancake/Uniswap ABI: the deployed KnightRouter ABI and deployed library hash/fee calculations are authoritative. Source-service creation/runtime match labels are retained without relabeling them exact_match or implying a fresh bytecode or dependency attestation.

sourceSemantics.routing: Caller address[] path contains tokens, not arbitrary executor payloads. Pair addresses derive by CREATE2 from immutable factory 0xf0bc2E21a76513aa7CC2730C7A1D6deE0790751f, sorted token salt and fixed init-code hash 0x4f28dfdda4977962d01e311877b42e2a192039a7276c57cc348ff240475368ee. Both swap loops pass new bytes(0) to pair.swap. No external swap-mining/reward hook or arbitrary-call dispatcher exists in this reviewed router.
sourceSemantics.pricing: Deployed PancakeLibrary uses amountIn*998 over reserveIn*1000+amountIn*998; exact-output input uses reserveIn*amountOut*1000 / ((reserveOut-amountOut)*998) + 1. This is reviewed library arithmetic, not an assertion of live pair fee compatibility, pool behavior, liquidity or price. Standard swap quote helpers require path.length >= 2; supporting paths instead index path directly and rely on their execution/balance checks.
sourceSemantics.liquidity: Missing pair may be created through fixed factory. Empty-reserve branch uses both desired amounts without minimum checks. Existing-reserve branch checks only optimized-side minimum, not both desired-side minima. No minimum LP-output argument. Non-permit removal transfers caller LP to derived pair, burns and checks calculated amountA/amountB minima and deadline; native removal uses router custody before token transfer/unwrap.
sourceSemantics.native: Immutable WETH is canonical BSC WBNB. ETH-named calls spend BNB. Four payable entries: addLiquidityETH, swapETHForExactTokens, swapExactETHForTokens and its fee-supporting variant. Native add/exact-output swap refund unused value to msg.sender; native outputs unwrap then call recipient with empty calldata. receive accepts only fixed WBNB; it creates no capability.
sourceSemantics.feeSupporting: Per-hop input is pair token balance minus reserve, priced with deployed 998/1000 arithmetic. Token-output swaps check recipient balance increase. removeLiquidityETHSupportingFeeOnTransferTokens forwards entire router token balance after burn accounting; swapExactTokensForETHSupportingFeeOnTransferTokens checks/unwraps entire router WBNB balance. Burn minimums do not guarantee recipient net post-tax token output.
sourceSemantics.transferDependencies: TransferHelper performs fixed-selector token transfer/transferFrom calls, accepts empty returndata or decoded true and reverts on failure; its unused safeApprove is internal and not an exposed capability. Wrapped-token transfer asserts true. LP transferFrom return is not checked by router, though pair burn is subsequent. Token, pair, factory and wrapped-native dependency behavior is not freshly attested.
sourceSemantics.excluded: Seven read-only getters/quotes and three signature-bearing permit removals are excluded. All 24 ABI functions are individually inventoried. Constructor and receive are preserved in full ABI but do not create capabilities. No farms, staking, rewards, approvals/transfers, callbacks or arbitrary executors are admitted.
sourceSemantics.lifecycle: Official historical contracts documentation remains reachable and attributes deployment. This admission makes no claim that a trading frontend, incentives, current configuration or executable liquidity remain available.
